chunks: He will ask: "O Lord, why have you raised me blind when I was able to see?"
ai.seo_question: Why does the disbeliever ask Allah why he was raised blind on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a profound metaphor for the transition from physical sight to spiritual insight, where the disbeliever’s loss of vision symbolizes the failure to recognize divine truth during life. The rhetorical question underscores the irony of being resurrected in a state of blindness despite having had the capacity to see, emphasizing that true sight is rooted in faith and perception of God's signs. This concept aligns with the broader Islamic teaching that spiritual blindness is a consequence of ignoring divine guidance.
